hints.title: Subarray Operations Overview
hints.text: Support three operations: point updates, range exclusive-or evaluation, and reversing an interval.

hints.title: Interval Reversal Simulation
hints.text: Reverse the subsegment between indices left and right in place.

hints.title: Range Value Aggregation
hints.text: Accumulate bitwise exclusive-or sum over the subsegment.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct array simulation handles point assignments, reversals, and range queries.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Without in-place mutations, full copies on each reversal degrade memory performance.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear auxiliary space stores the working array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Implement range reversals and bitwise exclusive-or accumulations cleanly.
